dxgive.evidence_source: [/page/6/Text/9] The findings from this study suggest that IPT-AST can decrease symptoms and improve functioning in adolescents with elevated depression symptoms. Furthermore, adolescents who participate in IPT-AST may be less likely to develop a depressive illness than adolescents who receive regular school counseling. These results point to the promise of IPT-AST as an intervention for adolescents with subthreshold depression.
